text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During training, Yukino Bijin drops by to bring us some bottles of refreshing water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says the way Gold City runs is beautiful, but Gold City complains she'd rather be told she was strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin insists that by "beautiful" she's not referring only to Gold City's looks. Instead, it describes everything about her, including her strength and amazing skill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City thinks back and laughs. Perhaps this is what some people had meant when talking about her all along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Gold City gives a hearty laugh, Yukino Bijin tells her that she's more beautiful than ever, and Gold City agrees that she likes herself better now, too.
